reading: The number of ship attacks near the Strait of Hormuz is very high.
Twelve ships were attacked in just one week.
Experts say Iran wants to control the water.
One attack caused a fire on a large tanker.
Teams rescued eleven sailors, but two men are missing.
Middle East oil exports have slowed because of these attacks.
